as_of.initialization_note: Arlequino and Rena remain at a Dwargon caravan/merchant information counter. The Eurazania inquiry has advanced from destruction news to a partial route result: evacuation traffic was split, with several large groups recorded moving northeast toward the Jura/Tempest direction and other groups diverted through temporary camps/secondary routes. Exact current distribution and individual names remain unresolved.

processes.current_state: Rena and Arlequino are still using the current contact for Eurazania information. No organizer candidate has yet been identified or contacted.
constraints: Scope is broader than one concert.
Rena chooses her own method consistent with character and knowledge.
No organizer acceptance may be fabricated before contacts and time exist.

processes.objective: Determine through causal in-world channels where Eurazania evacuees were sent and where they can currently be found.
processes.current_state: The current caravan/merchant clerk checked recent route entries. Partial result: evacuation traffic was split. Several large civilian groups were recorded moving northeast through trade routes toward the Jura/Tempest direction before the destruction; other groups were diverted to temporary road camps and secondary routes. The desk has no complete individual-name list and cannot prove final arrival points for all groups.

constraints: No omniscient access to evacuation records.
Do not infer the condition of 18 Old Garden Street from city-wide destruction alone.
